question: Which components in the minimal 46-node physical graph write each of the two task-conditioned rank-four response programs, and do their exact weight maps explain the task split?

novelty_search.temporal_source_graph: The rank46 graph identifies necessary physical support but does not assign task-rank-four edge weights.
novelty_search.task_mode_factorial: The task-mode experiments identify two causal response subspaces but do not trace their upstream native writers.
novelty_search.weight_usage: Existing MLP quadratic and attention OV analyses compare task usage at the eight response sites, not source-component-to-response edges across the rank46 graph.
novelty_search.collision: No existing authority combines full head/module patching of every rank46 source with frozen task-rank-four response coordinates and exact weight pullbacks.

decision: Promote only edges that are both causally live under full module/head patching and compatible with the exact local weight pullback. Treat weight overlap without causal response as capacity, and causal response without weight closure as an unresolved nonlinear/contextual edge.
